checks: Named row bindings and correlation calculate through GTC; table edits refresh the measurement
Dragging a plot point updates uncertainty inputs; undo restores the previous measurement
Changing the measurement definition is an undoable action; checkpoint restoration retains its matching result
Fresh installed-host process restores the saved definition and result without recomputation
Ratio and shared input identity are visible choices; A/A cancels exactly, and unsharing re-enables input B
Stop is undoable and restores its previous measurement
mode: Extension installed in an isolated profile, not extension development mode
scope: Desktop UI and normal process restart; not crash recovery
